Can the housekeeping staff start cleaning all the rooms by 2 o'clock?
A. There's a house for sale on Taylor Street.
B. Some hotel guests check out late.
C. We offer morning and afternoon flights.
context.transcript_translation:
客房服务人员能在两点前开始清洁所有房间吗？
A. Taylor街有一栋待售的房子。
B. 有些酒店客人退房时间晚。
C. 我们提供上午和下午的航班。
